title: AI Writing Has a Shape! #ai #chatgpt #claude
description:
Can AI writing detection actually spot the difference between bots and people?

New research shows that AI models follow specific structural patterns that make them predictable, while human writing remains naturally scattered. This analysis explains why AI detection reaches 93% accuracy and what separates machine output from human creativity.

Subscribe for more breakdowns on how AI technology works.

top_comments.author: @khublaklonk4480
top_comments.text:
I'm glancing nervously at my work emails that explain every little point with surgical precision and ridiculous levels of over-explaining.  

How did I end up this way?  I've been conditioned not by machine learning, but by decades of work practice in which people will, somehow, manage to get the wrong end of the stick unless you secure the edges of every pettifogging little detail with a metaphorical nail gun. And there's still someone who manages to get it arse-about-face anyway. It's strangely impressive, sometimes.
